prompt: SCOTTISH OPEN GOLF PREDICTION MASTER PROMPT v1.0
method: Walk-forward: each Scottish Open edition is scored with results that ended before its first round only. Fields are reconstructed from the event result rows. Tee times and the round-one forecast are not available historically, so the thirty-point wave category is missing for every past edition and no first-round-leader tip can read HIGH. Strokes gained is applied only to the current season and only when the field clears the coverage floor.

editions.name: Genesis Scottish Open
editions.strokesGained: not applied (no historical snapshot for this season)
missing: strokes gained (no free per-player strokes-gained source for this field, so the ball-striking and putting categories score zero and are marked missing)
round-one wave forecast (round-one forecast not collected for this event; the wave category scores zero for every player and no first-round-leader tip can read HIGH)
venue history (fewer than two prior editions of this tournament in the sourced tape, so the wind and links proxy is the primary substitute for course knowledge)
odds (no free key-less bookmaker odds source exists, so OWGR rank within the field stands in for market favouritism in the value rule and the cross-reference of two bookmakers cannot be performed)
Race to Dubai standings (no free key-less standings feed, so the European incentive bonus is unassessed)
flags: no player met the strict value test; the mandatory value test asks for a course-fit score of fifteen or more, but the low-flight half of that category is not published by any free source, so twelve is the most a player can score there; the outside-the-top-five-favourites fallback is used instead and is written without the VALUE PICK label. Eric Cole is listed instead as the best-scoring player outside the top fifteen in the field, without the VALUE PICK label.
same player heads TOP EUROPEAN PLAYER and TOP GB AND IRELAND PLAYER — each market is written separately and justified on its own merits as the prompt requires
